profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Oracle | CS @ Columbia

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description: • Completed the following relevant coursework: Artificial Intelligence, Applied Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Cloud Computing, Advanced Software Engineering, Advanced Database Systems, Computer Networks, Analysis of Algorithms, 3D UI and Virtual Reality

company.name: Columbia University in the City of New York

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Devised and managed AWS cloud architecture for AI-based skin evaluation system at MedySapiens, a biotech startup in Series-A
specializing in cognitive computing for healthcare
• Expedited labeling medical image dataset by integrating AWS Sagemaker into workflow
• Improved classification accuracy of skin damage in new image dataset by 5%

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Columbia Computer Graphics and User Interfaces Lab (CGUI) 
• Developed a VR platform with Unity that allows multiple users to simultaneously interact with a map embedded with geotagged data (social media, real-time traffic, etc)
• Integrated Instagram and Yelp data to the platform and created map navigation functionalities

Columbia Computational Design Lab
• Built a Proof of Concept web application on which scientists can publish their work in the form of Twitter threads 

Columbia Computer Vision Laboratory (CAVE)
• Designed and deployed database of news articles to AWS cloud for the Cross Cultural Analysis Project, which aims to distinguish cultural differences between two countries presented in video news
• Implemented automation of keyword extraction and its analysis from video data
• Optimized search queries for video data collection by providing blacklist and whitelist words

company.name: Columbia University in the City of New York

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Enhanced test frameworks for computer vision applications on Snapdragon 855 chip for Samsung Galaxy S10
• Generated Python test scripts for DENSO robot arm to physically test the Snapdragon X50 5G modem
• Initiated and composed internal Python programming guide for the DENSO robot arm

positions.title: Advisory Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Established automation of member enrollment data at MetLife using BluePrism robotic process automation software
• Organized and directed training sessions on BluePrism for ten new interns and current employees
• Analyzed domestic fintech trends and compiled conclusion to senior partners

positions.title: Programming Director
positions.description:
• Led weekly curriculums on Python and Java for local underprivileged high school students
• Managed publicity team and published weekly newsletter containing details of upcoming tech panels and news
• Planned several fundraisers and raised total of $5,000 to fund transportation for students to Columbia campus
